title: Crispy Keto Mexican Chicken
description: A delicious low-carb keto recipe with crispy chicken, spicy paprika, and fresh cilantro.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together cumin, crispy paprika, and sweet paprika.
2. Add chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat with spice mixture.
3. Heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Add chicken to the skillet and fry until crispy, about 5-6 minutes per side.
5. Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
6. In the same skillet, add crispy tortilla strips and fry until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
7. Remove tortilla strips from the skillet and set aside.
8. In the same skillet, add chicken broth and stir to deglaze the pan.
9. Return chicken to the skillet and simmer in the sauce until heated through.
10. Serve chicken with crispy tortilla strips and garnish with chopped cilantro.
